Everything for your next make.

From the first colour idea to the last ball of yarn, all in one calm, simple app.

Main feature

Design my bag.

Enter your bag or tote’s size, choose your squares and how they’re arranged, then press Visualise my bag.

  • See a mock-up, even on a photo of your own tote
  • Check the squares fit before you start
  • Square counts, yarn per colour and step-by-step making instructions
  • Canvas lining, fully crocheted, or a panel on an existing tote
Granny squares

Round by round, in your colours.

Classic, Solid, Daisy, Sunburst, Tulip and Floral. Pick the rounds and colour each one; the pattern writes itself.

  • Full written pattern with stitch counts
  • Finished size from your yarn and hook
  • US or UK crochet terms
Colour studio

Colours straight from your yarn.

Snap a photo of your yarn and hookd picks out the colours. Tap any ball for its exact shade, then try them as checkerboard, stripes or granny squares.

  • Background colours spotted and left out
  • Friendly notes on contrast
  • Save palettes and compare them side by side
Learn and keep track

Your stitches and your stash.

Twelve stitches with chart symbols, clear steps and videos. And a yarn collection that knows what you already have.

  • Beginner to intermediate, with a skill filter
  • Photo of each yarn, its colour picked automatically
  • Balls and metres added up for you

Make it real ✨

Turn your bag or square into a realistic photo, on a sofa, a café table or a Maldives beach. Your own design guides the picture, so the colours and layout follow it.

Measurement calculator

Foundation chains, stitches and rows for blankets, totes, scarves, tops and granny square layouts, in cm or inches.

Yarn calculator

Metres, grams and balls for every colour, from your own yarn labels and swatch.

Projects

Start a project in a few simple steps, track progress, keep notes, photos and the designs that go with it.

Light, dark and your colour

Follows your iPhone’s light and dark mode, with background themes or a colour you pick.

US or UK terms

Every pattern and stitch switches between US and UK names, so “single crochet” or “double crochet” always means what you expect.

Works offline

Once it’s on your home screen, hookd opens even without internet. Your projects stay on your phone.

Add hookd to your phone.

No App Store needed. It takes about ten seconds, and hookd then opens full screen like any other app.

iPhone and iPad

  1. Open the hookd link in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button Share at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
  4. Open hookd from your home screen. That’s it.

Use Safari: on iPhone, only Safari can add hookd to the home screen.

Android

  1. Open the link in Chrome.
  2. Tap the menu ⋮ in the top corner.
  3. Tap Install app or Add to Home screen.

Your projects, palettes and yarn are saved on your phone, not online.

Ready when you are.

Grab your hook, pick your colours, and see it finished before the first stitch.
